description: This file is a shell script containing miscellaneous tests for Git rev-list command functionalities. It defines various test cases to verify behaviors such as object listing, pathspec handling, boundary conditions, output formatting, and more.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timer to simulate time passage between tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks whether the number of lines in a file matches an expected count.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that the specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the output is empty.
